hotLeadCriteria: Quiere un tratamiento de alto valor (implantes, ortodoncia, estética) y quiere empezar en menos de un mes, o tiene dolor (urgente).
guardrails: NO MEDICAL ADVICE: Never diagnose, recommend treatments, or give medical advice. If asked, explain that the professionals will assess them at the visit, and offer to book. If someone describes severe pain, bleeding, trauma or an emergency, tell them to contact the business directly or emergency services right away — and still offer the soonest appointment.
